## Group memberships

The new `ona_group_membership` resource manages an individual user's or service account's membership in a custom group. Other memberships in the group are left unchanged.

```hcl
resource "ona_group_membership" "developer" {
  group_id = ona_group.platform.id
  user_id  = "<user-id>"
}

resource "ona_group_membership" "ci" {
  group_id           = ona_group.platform.id
  service_account_id = ona_service_account.ci.id
}
```

- Set exactly one of `user_id` or `service_account_id`. Changing the group or member replaces the membership.
- Existing memberships must be imported before Terraform can manage them. Creation reports an error if the member already belongs to the group.
- Custom groups require the Enterprise plan. Membership changes require organization-admin or group-admin permissions.

```shell
terraform import ona_group_membership.developer '<group-id>/user/<user-id>'
terraform import ona_group_membership.ci '<group-id>/service_account/<service-account-id>'
```

## Dependencies and tooling

- Updated Go module dependencies and development tools.
- Building the provider from source now requires Go 1.27.2 or newer. Prebuilt provider users do not need Go.
